Accessory originally called the raw entry directly and bypassed driver_input_lock. Adapt its completion to hid_safe_input_report with actual length for both extents so native probe/remove quiescing, missing-driver/empty-report rejection and normal HID/BPF processing apply. No new KMI wrapper or old core implementation. The accessory HID driver has no raw_event callback; other bound HID drivers/BPF now receive their normal native callbacks, subject to native locking. EP0/HID pointer lifetime remains separately unresolved; wrapper locking alone cannot keep a freed HID object alive.
